title: It's live: the Digital Ceasefire & De-escalation Platform
body_markdown:
The Digital Ceasefire & De-escalation Platform is now live. You can [read the Handbook](#/handbook) section by section, or [build your own Agreement](#/builder) from its model provisions and download it as Word, Markdown or PDF.

The Platform is an initiative of the [Human Rights Center](https://humanrights.berkeley.edu/) at UC Berkeley School of Law.
